referee_caveats_inferred: Only one EB calibrated; short on-source time
Keplerian model fit to first-moment map ignores cavity and beam smearing; chi^2 uses arbitrary sigma of 0.5 km/s and uncorrelated pixels
Uniform-disk uvmodelfit is a crude dust model with no uncertainties on shape parameters
Distance ambiguity (99 vs 116 pc) affects all linear scales and masses
